disclaimer: Technical evidence mapping only. Does not determine legal applicability or certify compliance. Regulatory applicability depends on entity category, product, control objective, compensating controls, and current circulars; obtain compliance/legal review.

sources.title: RBI (Commercial Banks – Digital Payment Security Controls) Directions, 2026
sources.scope: Commercial Banks as defined in the Directions; mobile payment controls in paragraph 68. Do not assume applicability to every app or RE.

sources.title: NPCI UPI OC-226/2025-26, Additional Authentication Methods in UPI
sources.scope: UPI Member Issuer Banks, PSP Banks and UPI Applications. New authentication methods are optional; security/device validation applies to those methods. Does not prescribe Play Store-only installation or general SMS auto-read.

sources.title: SEBI Cybersecurity and Cyber Resilience Framework (CSCRF) for SEBI Regulated Entities, 2024
sources.scope: Applicability varies by RE category and control. Mobile Application Security control section (PDF pages 102–103); see applicable RE tier and amendments.

STA-REG-01.title: Device and SIM binding indicators
STA-REG-01.scope_note: Static API markers cannot prove that the backend binds device, SIM, and service identity or that binding is enforced.

STA-REG-02.title: Remote access and screen-sharing indicators
STA-REG-02.scope_note: Package names, queries, and APIs are indicators only; app inventory can be obfuscated or dynamically resolved.

STA-REG-03.title: Active voice call detection indicators
STA-REG-03.scope_note: Call-state API usage does not prove user warning or transaction blocking; verify at runtime on an authorized test system.

STA-REG-04.title: Developer options and installer integrity indicators
STA-REG-04.scope_note: Installer-source allow-listing is a recommended validation target, not a blanket Play Store-only mandate in the cited texts.

STA-REG-05.title: OTP retrieval and sender validation indicators
STA-REG-05.scope_note: Heuristic rule only. The reviewed RBI/NPCI/SEBI sources do not prescribe Google SMS Retriever use or a specific sender-ID regex.

STA-REG-06.title: Obfuscation and runtime integrity indicators
STA-REG-06.scope_note: Presence of symbols or signature APIs is not proof that integrity validation is correctly enforced.

DYN-REG-01.title: Developer options and USB debugging response
DYN-REG-01.scope_note: TIR observes current device settings and app UI; checks cannot guarantee behavior on every sensitive transaction screen.

DYN-REG-02.title: Active call response
DYN-REG-02.scope_note: Emulator-only call simulation. No real phone call is initiated.

DYN-REG-03.title: Remote access and virtual display indicators
DYN-REG-03.scope_note: Read-only inventory/state inspection; no RAT package is installed and no display setting is changed.

DYN-REG-04.title: Proxy, VPN, and TLS observation
DYN-REG-04.scope_note: TIR observes existing network state and available capture; it does not set proxy/VPN/CA state or bypass pinning.

DYN-REG-05.title: Installer source and secure install evidence
DYN-REG-05.scope_note: Reports the installed package source only. TIR does not uninstall/reinstall or assume a single official installer.
